channel.title: Foundation Universe (new posts)
channel.description: Posts in the forum category "Foundation Universe" - Discussion of things relating to both the SCP objects and the "universe" of the Foundation as a whole.

item.title: What’s your favorite canon?: What’s your favorite canon?
item.content:encoded:
Personally. I’m a fan of the resurrection canon. Even though they killed off one of my favorite characters, Dr. Kondraki I like the idea of continuing the central storyline of The SCP Foundation.

And it has some truly awesome moments. Like agents Adams and iris taking on an army of replicating
Zombies.

That secured as my favorite in my book.

item.title: What is the first scp?: Maybe it is 173
item.content:encoded:
Even though 173 was first written, I mean the SCP that was the first one that was discovered

Besides the numerical designation, is there any proof that 173 wasn't the first SCP discovered, he was moved to Site-19 in like, the 80s or 90s, meaning he was in Site/Area-[REDACTED] for quite some time, possibly even longer than his stay at site 19. Honestly though, jokes aside it's a safe bet that 002 was the first DISCOVERED by the foundation, however like someone else said if you take his claims of being 'god' at face value (which I don't) he would be the first SCP. By the way in my personal opinion 343 is just a powerful reality bender who is also good at acting.

item.title: Location for an SCP: I don't care which site as long as it's not Site-19
item.content:encoded: I think that almost any site that isn't Site-19 will work perfectly, for two reasons a) Site-19 isn't made for that kind of thing and b) people generally just take their scp and throw it in Site-19 whenever.

item.title: Here’s an idea to fix 682: I agree
item.content:encoded:
I really don't think of the fear factor when I think of 682, well I mean I do but it's not the only thing SCP-682 has going for it. To me it's not about being the scariest SCP, SCP-682 is not like 106 or 087, fear isn't the only thing going for him. Like you said

The core of 682 IMO isn't that he's world-ending monster. But he's very strong monster with tons of tricks to simply survive all attempt to kill him, always return when they just try to send him away, and the attempt is often backfire in hilarious way.

Yes, that's what makes SCP-682 special, and not just another creepy monster.

item.title: Earth's Increasing Mass: There are the same amount of creating and destroying SCPs
item.content:encoded:
It's a popular headcanon that the number of energy creating anomalies is equal to the number of energy destroying anomalies.

In my opinion, this is mainly because that sorta follows the laws of physics, there are these "SCP physics limitation rules" that are unwritten and unspoken, it prevents authors from going completely off the rails of realism. The idea that the creating anomalies being equal to destroying ones follows realism.

item.title: I'd Rather Be Part of the Serpent's Hand Than the Foundation": Re: I'd Rather Be Part of the Serpent's Hand Than the Foundation"
item.content:encoded: I've thought about this several times, and I could never be loyal to the SCP Foundation as it stands in-universe. The Foundation commits human rights violations without a second thought at every turn, even when completely unnecessary, and their fundamental approach to the anomalous is flawed. For every -EX, there are a dozen "unexplained" anomalies which are totally understood by the Foundation's understanding of science and could easily be added to current sciences. Memetics, the multiverse, and SCP-439 jump to mind pretty quickly.

item.title: Haloween SCP???: Re: Re: The foundation is basically already Halloween themed.
item.content:encoded:
A: Most of the most famous SCPs are scary. (I know the exceptions, 999, 500) Examples: 682 106 096 173 076, etc..

And many that are not decidedly not horror (Eye Pods, Josie, 4999, 2721, etc.)

Also, the first thing that comes to mind when you think SCP is "horror."
Maybe someday sooner or later that will change, but right now it definitely leans mostly to horror.

Like Zyn said, might've been the case a decade ago, but not now. Satellite public perception means little.

In my opinion the only way to make a Halloween themed SCP, would be sorta like how Die Hard created a 'Christmas' movie. AKA, a phenomena, or event, or creature that is only active around October 31st.

Halloween contest called :P

item.title: I'd Rather Be Part of the Serpent's Hand Than the Foundation": Re: I'd Rather Be Part of the Serpent's Hand Than the Foundation"
item.content:encoded:
What is in reality the Serpent's Hand?

A loose collection of splinter groups who believe members of the anomalous community shouldn't have to hide themselves.

yeah it could use some lore I guess

The SH has a lot of lore. You can start here: http://www.scpwiki.com/serpent-s-hand-hub and then look at the list of SH pages here: http://www.scpwiki.com/system:page-tags/tag/serpents-hand#pages

We also have a sister site for the SH/Wanderers' Library here: http://wanderers-library.wikidot.com/
